'''Volume 50''' is the 50th volume of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga and the eighth volume in the {{MangaArc|Black & White}}. It is authored by [[Hidenori Kusaka]] and illustrated by [[Satoshi Yamamoto]].

The volume also has a special limited release in Japan that includes a separate art book, [[Pokémon Special Illustrations]], consisting of 64 pages of color illustrations that have been released over the series' run.

In [[VIZ Media]]'s translation, this volume is published as volume eight of a separately numbered series, "Pokémon Adventures: Black & White".

==Blurb==
''Team Plasma's King, N, has shaken Black's faith in his relationship with his Pokémon. But just when Black is about to call it quits and go home, he gets a last-minute chance earn the final Pokémon badge he needs to be eligible to compete in the Pokémon League! Black's friends Iris and Cheren are competing too. Unfortunately, kind and thoughtful Cheren is starting to change...''

''Will Black fufill''<sup>[sic]</sup>'' his dream of winning the Pokémon League?''

==Important events==
{{spoilers}}
* The {{un|Pokémon League}} begins.
* {{adv|Black}} defeats [[Drayden]].
* Black enters the Pokémon League.
* A disguised {{adv|Looker}} is revealed to be investigating the [[Seven Sages]].
* The [[Shadow Triad]] attempt to capture the [[Swords of Justice]], but fail.
* [[Team Plasma]] is revealed to be training a {{p|Genesect|secret project}}.
* [[Chili]], [[Cilan]], and [[Cress]] challenge the Shadow Triad.
* Black and {{adv|Cheren}} battle each other in the finals.
* Cheren is revealed to have been manipulated by Team Plasma.
* Black defeats Cheren.
* Musha returns to Black.
* Black awakens {{p|Reshiram}} and challenges Team Plasma to show themselves.
